## Problem

Cell therapy manufacturing requires rigorous genomic quality control to ensure product safety and consistency. Manual analysis of NGS data is error-prone, time-consuming, and difficult to standardize across batches. Regulatory requirements demand comprehensive documentation and traceability.

## Solution

Developed an automated genomic QC pipeline with:

- **Data Processing**: Automated alignment, variant calling, and quality metrics calculation
- **Quality Gates**: Predefined acceptance criteria for genomic integrity
- **Visualization**: Interactive dashboards for batch-level QC review
- **Reporting**: Automated generation of regulatory-compliant reports
- **Traceability**: Complete audit trail from raw data to final decision

The pipeline processes samples in parallel, reducing analysis time from days to hours while improving accuracy and consistency.

## Technologies

- **Python**: Pipeline orchestration and data processing
- **Bioinformatics Tools**: BWA, GATK, SAMtools, FastQC
- **Visualization**: Plotly, matplotlib for interactive plots
- **Infrastructure**: Docker containers for reproducible environments
- **Version Control**: Git for code and analysis versioning

## Outcomes

- Reduced QC analysis time by 85% (from 3 days to 4 hours per batch)
- Eliminated manual transcription errors in quality reports
- Enabled real-time decision-making during manufacturing
- Successfully passed regulatory inspection with full audit trail
- Adopted as standard QC workflow across multiple manufacturing sites
- Processed over 500 clinical batches with zero quality escapes

The pipeline demonstrates how automation and bioinformatics can strengthen quality systems in cell therapy manufacturing while accelerating time-to-patient.
